def factor_price_volume_demand_confirmation(df):
    """Price-volume demand confirmation via rolling correlation of price and volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    volume_safe = df_copy["volume"].replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ret = volume_safe.pct_change()
    corr = close_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(vol_ret)
    corr = corr.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_demand_confirmation"] = corr
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_demand_confirmation"]
description: Ablation mutation of the parent preserves the core price-volume demand-confirmation mechanism: a positive rolling correlation between price returns and volume changes indicates synchronized demand pressure, which tends to persist after industry and size neutralization. The volatility-stress multiplier from the tail-risk modifier is removed because it can amplify noisy regimes and destabilize cross-sectional ranking; a shorter 20-day correlation window makes the signal more responsive while retaining a single clear economic mechanism.
